title: Policy: `WAI-Spoke` Integrity During Testing
description: During testing and development, the contents of the `WAI-Spoke/` folder (including `WAI-State.json`) are to be treated as read-only unless explicit instructions are given to modify specific files. The CLI and framework must be designed to inform and empower the `WAI-Spoke` content, not modify or destroy it without explicit user interaction and confirmation. Testing procedures that involve modifying `WAI-Spoke` files will be explicitly defined and confirmed by the user. Automatic modification of `WAI-Spoke/WAI-State.json` (e.g., for persisting `hub_path`) is prohibited in testing contexts without explicit user directive.
resolution_reason: Policy reviewed and incorporated into agent operational guidelines.
